verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Sentry's trace, LLM-call, cost and dashboard views in the UI, but nothing shows an API or MCP server that lets a user's agent query traces, metrics, or eval results. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. llms.txt, Seer (Sentry's own debugging agent) and the official CLI do not establish programmatic query access for an external agent, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent query my traces, metrics, and eval results through an API or MCP server to debug my app
